name: browser-use
headline: 00 claude skills for ai automation
short_description: A curated collection of 328 validated Claude Code skills organized across 17 plugin categories, sourced from 11 projects. Designed for developers using Claude Code who want to extend its capabilities via a standardized plugin structure.
author: Freddy-CHEN-ux

sections.overview:
00_claude_skills is a structured collection of 328 validated skills for Claude Code, aggregated from 11 source projects and organized into 17 plugin categories. Categories span AI & ML, Software Development, Testing & QA, DevOps, Documentation, Git & VCS, Data Analytics, E-commerce Integration, Design & Creative, and more. The repository includes a standardized skill structure, plugin marketplace configuration, and complete documentation in both English and Chinese. A template directory and spec folder help developers create and contribute new skills following consistent conventions. It is intended for developers and teams looking to systematically expand Claude Code's automation capabilities across diverse workflows.
Extending Claude Code with pre-built skills for software development and testing workflows
Automating DevOps and Git version control tasks using validated Claude Code plugins
Integrating Claude Code into e-commerce, marketing, or business startup workflows
Using the provided templates and specs to author and publish new Claude Code skills
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Freddy-CHEN-ux/00_claude_skills`
sections.usage:
```
Help me automate a repetitive task using [TOOL_NAME]. I need to [DESCRIBE_TASK] every [FREQUENCY]. What steps should I follow to automate this process?
```
